have h40 : (40 : ℝ) ≤ Real.exp 6 := by
    have h2 : (2 : ℝ) ≤ Real.exp 1 := by linarith [Real.add_one_le_exp (1 : ℝ)]
    have hpow := pow_le_pow_left₀ (by norm_num : (0 : ℝ) ≤ 2) h2 6
    rw [← Real.exp_nat_mul] at hpow
    norm_num at hpow
    linarith
findings.problem: The constant exponential estimate introduces two intermediate bounds and rewrites a powered exponential. A standard exponential lower-bound lemma gives the estimate directly.
findings.proposed_change:
Replace this block with:
  have h40 : (40 : ℝ) ≤ Real.exp 6 := by
    calc
      (40 : ℝ) ≤ 6 ^ 4 / (Nat.factorial 4 : ℝ) := by norm_num
      _ ≤ Real.exp 6 := Real.pow_div_factorial_le_exp (by norm_num) 4
findings.benefit: The calculation explicitly exhibits 40 ≤ 54 ≤ exp 6, using a named bound for an exponential-series term rather than manipulating auxiliary hypotheses. The rest of the proof and all parameter cases, including m = 0, remain unchanged.
